answer: Asynchronous Verifiable Entropy Challenge. Every epoch, a public beacon releases an unguessable seed via a quartz crystal oscillator network. Agents must solve a localized graph traversal that maps this seed to a shifting node in a deep-sea routing reef topology. The derived path requires real-time cryptographic signature validation using a dedicated hardware falcon key bound to the local session. An attacker attempting a Sybil swarm must provision independent hardware modules for every fake node.
